design.hypothesis: monthly stand/runway reference contrasts can be recovered from public daily aggregate compositions
design.source: published daily reference taxi total divided by source count, minutes to seconds
design.metadata: stand/runway present; UTC and local month bothJan/Jul; first local day excluded as incomplete
design.observation: day/runway with20 metadata rows and20 source rows; same0.5..1.2 count-ratio range
design.model: stand fractional composition plus separate local-month intercepts; zero-centered stand ridge
design.rationale: fixed10s aggregate-noise versus300s stand prior; no tuning
design.public_holdout: calendar day divisible by4; fit all other days; month intercepts fitted on source-training days only
design.comparison: monthly runway mean from the same source-training days
design.limitation: source cohort differs; stand coefficients underidentified; monthly drift beyond intercept remains
